description: Step 1 of 2: prepare a draft report of something seen in the sky, without publishing or sending anything. Returns a summary to show the witness, a draft id and a secret token, and, when place and time are given, the immediate explanation. Then, only after the witness explicitly agrees, call submit_sighting_report; otherwise cancel_sighting_report. Drafts expire after 10 minutes; at most 5 drafts per client per hour.

az.description: Measured direction in degrees from north, if any.

consent.description: true once the witness has said they want to report this sighting (asked before drafting). Their approval of the summary is a second, separate agreement, required before submit_sighting_report. If false, the tool asks for it.

date_heure.description: When it was seen, ISO-8601 with a time zone.

description.description: What was seen, in the witness's words.

el.description: Measured height above the horizon in degrees, if any.

lat.description: Witness latitude (rounded to about 1 km before publication).

lon.description: Witness longitude (rounded to about 1 km before publication).

prenom.description: Optional first name shown on the public record; 'Anonyme' if omitted.

ville.description: Town or city of the observation.

name: draft_sighting_report

outputSchema.description: Returns status (pending), action_id, jeton (secret token), expires_dans_secondes, resume_a_montrer_au_temoin, explication_immediate, publication (what becomes public); or status elicitation_requise / limite_atteinte.

title: Draft a sighting report (step 1 of 2)
